verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live, keyless llms.txt at askjo.ai/llms.txt (text/plain). It explicitly tells agents to prefer it over scraping the site. It documents surfaces, integrations, architecture, model routing and pricing. A machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec is also served publicly. Missing for 10: no deeper agent-oriented reference docs (e.g., an llms-full.txt or developer docs wrapping the OpenAPI spec) beyond the product-overview llms.txt.
